name: Arcadia
source:
A perfectly independent AI from a time long before even the 'ancient people'. He caused a great disaster and was locked away.
He was also the ringleader behind the destruction of the ancient people 3000 years ago.
Now he is working with [url=/c48272]Row[/url] to find [url=/c48267]Eve[/url] for his own reasons.
